text: The code compiles. The tests pass. But does the commit say anything? Does that comment explain why? Sometimes the next improvement needs a different kind of check.
A formatter knows where the semicolon goes. nudgement asks whether the thought holds up.
nudgement reviews commit messages, code comments, tests and documentation. Run it yourself or let your coding agent use the findings to revise its work.
Each evaluator sends Jev the relevant context and a set of focused questions. For a commit, that includes checking whether the message matches the diff.
The default test command replays saved responses instead of making paid API calls.
Would this test still pass if the implementation returned the wrong booking date?
The pencil in the margin marks your reading position as you scroll.
Jev can miss problems or flag useful code. Read the findings before accepting an edit.
Unlock a new dimension of thoughtful work. Empower every idea to reach its fullest potential.
